journey.name: lnurl pay without spending balance is refused
journey.description:
Verifies that pasting an LNURL-pay link while the wallet has no Lightning spending balance is refused with the capacity warning, and that the Send sheet stays on the recipient options instead of opening the LNURL amount or confirmation screens. The app has to resolve the pay request from the LNURL server first, because the minimum it compares the balance against comes from that response, so this journey also proves the simulator reaches the server.
Precondition: an onboarded E2E build on regtest with the node running and no channels, so the Spending balance is zero. The LNURL-pay link is the `lnurl` field of the `GET /generate/pay` response of the `bitkit-docker` `lnurl-server` fixture, read from the server address the app reaches (see README.md). Copy it to the simulator clipboard (`xcrun simctl pbcopy <udid>`). The fixture mode does not matter here, the invoice callback is never called. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Verify the SPENDING balance on the home screen is 0
If a camera permission dialog appears, dismiss it by choosing "Don't Allow"
If the iOS dialog about pasting from another app appears (the first paste of a build), choose "Allow Paste"

Straight after that, without waiting for another screen refresh because the toast fades after about 2.5 seconds, verify a warning toast titled "Unable To Pay (LNURL)" with the text "Not enough outbound/sending capacity to complete lnurl-pay request." appears (id "LnurlPayNoCapacityToast")
Verify the Send sheet is still on the recipient options (id "RecipientManual" is visible) and neither the LNURL amount screen (id "SendNumberField") nor a review screen (id "SendConfirm") was opened
Close the Send sheet and verify the wallet home screen is shown
